title: Six BTS Members Return to Seoul After LA Finale; Suga Stays Behind
detail: September 8–9, 2026 — RM, Jin, J-Hope, Jimin, V and Jungkook were photographed arriving at Incheon International Airport after wrapping the ARIRANG World Tour's North American leg with the SoFi Stadium finale, but Suga was notably absent from the group. Outlets reported he stayed behind in Los Angeles for a separate personal or professional commitment rather than flying home with his bandmates. A viral video that circulated on Sept 11 claiming to show his return was identified by fans as recycled June footage. On Sept 12, Suga posted an Instagram Story of a store shelf stocked with Japanese instant noodles and snacks, captioned '반갑고만' ('Nice to see you'), fueling speculation he had traveled to Japan — though his exact whereabouts remained unconfirmed as of Sept 13 reporting.

media.caption: Six BTS members return to Incheon International Airport; Suga stays in Los Angeles.
